BELIEF_STATE: UNDERSTANDING: Module responsibility: Provide RTK-style first-class command shortcuts, direct local adapters, and shell-aware hook-facing rewrite decisions that route or compact token-heavy command surfaces. Key data flows: - INPUT: RtkProxyCmd flags, JsonCmd/DepsCmd/EnvCmd/WcCmd args, RewriteCmd trailing args, and raw command strings from agent hooks. - PROCESSING: Validate required shortcut args, prefix native executables, delegate shortcuts to ProxyCmd, render local adapter summaries directly, and use CommandRouter for per-segment rewrite decisions. - OUTPUT: Same filtered output, route preview, raw evidence hint, tracking, exit-code behavior, local compact adapter output, and hook rewrite strings or safe shell chains as syn proxy. Critical invariants: - Shortcuts must not bypass M-PROXY filtering, tracking, or evidence capture. - Direct local adapters must record adapter-level token economics through M-TRACKING. - Hooks must use syn rewrite instead of maintaining separate command-family or chain-rewrite lists. - Shell-aware rewrite may only handle safe &&, ||, and ; sequences; pipe, redirection, heredoc, and substitution constructs stay pass-through. - Shortcut flags --route and --evidence remain behaviorally identical to syn proxy. - MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, CHANGE_SUMMARY, and semantic anchors stay synchronized. IMPLEMENTATION_STRATEGY: Approach: Keep shell-backed shortcuts as thin CLI wrappers over ProxyCmd, implement structured-data adapters locally, and keep hooks as thin delegates to shell-aware rewrite_command. Complexity_areas: clap trailing args, command flags beginning with hyphen, shell quoting, shell operator safety, exit-code propagation, safe environment masking, bounded JSON/dependency summaries. Patterns_applied: explicit delegation, typed links, shared proxy execution path, router-backed per-segment rewrite decisions, direct adapter tracking. VERIFICATION_INTENT: I expect the following to be true after my code runs: - syn read --evidence filters stdout with the cat filter and writes complete raw evidence. - syn git --route status shows the same route decision as syn proxy --route -- git status. - syn json --keys-only, syn deps, syn env --filter, and syn wc emit compact output and record adapter savings. - syn rewrite git status prints syn proxy -- git status without executing it. - syn rewrite "git status && cargo test" prints a proxied command chain without executing it. - verify_project and review_code pass with no MyGRACE drift. RISKS_ACKNOWLEDGED: - Native command availability differs by host; integration tests should use POSIX-stable cat behavior. - Additional specialized command-specific adapters may still be needed after local JSON/deps/env/wc parity. - Full shell language support is intentionally out of scope for Phase-29; unsupported constructs must fail closed.
